high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a media player interface on an iPhone, displaying the movie "Rain Man." The screen shows the movie poster as the background, featuring two men walking side by side on a road. One man is wearing a light-colored jacket and light-colored pants, while the other is dressed in a dark blazer and light-colored pants, carrying a bag over his shoulder. The title "RAIN MAN" is prominently displayed in large white letters at the bottom of the poster. Below the poster, the word "Rain Man" is written again, indicating the name of the movie or episode being played.
